title: Months Covered by a Disposable Filter Line for Established Patients — PAP Supply Replenishment Program
content:
**Clause.** The months a coverage-billed disposable-filter (A7038) line of the PAP Supply Replenishment Program covers are:

- the schedule's maximum months per shipment, for a patient enrolled 12 or more months whose enrollment shows four or more coverage-billed filter lines shipped in the last 12 months;
- **two months**, for a patient enrolled 6 or more months whose enrollment shows two or three such lines.

A patient who meets neither condition receives no extended span under this clause.

## Terms

- **Months enrolled:** whole calendar months from the enrollment date to the handling day.
- **Coverage-billed filter lines in the last 12 months:** shipped lines of disposable filters billed to coverage on the enrollment, with a ship date fewer than 12 whole calendar months before the handling day. Lines are counted, not units.

## Truth table

| Months enrolled | Coverage-billed filter lines in the last 12 months | Months the line covers |
|---|---|---|
| 12 or more | 4 or more | the schedule's maximum months per shipment |
| 12 or more | 2 or 3 | 2 |
| 6 to 11 | 2 or 3 | 2 |
| 6 to 11 | 4 or more | no extended span |
| any | 0 or 1 | no extended span |
| fewer than 6 | any | no extended span |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- Enrolled 30 months, five filter lines in the last 12 months: the line covers the schedule's maximum months per shipment.
- Enrolled 9 months, three filter lines: two months.
- Enrolled 9 months, four filter lines: neither condition holds (four lines needs 12 months enrolled; two months needs two or three lines), so no extended span.
